questions.q: Under 21 CFR 11.50, what must a signed electronic record show?
options: The signer's job title, department and site
Name, date and time, and meaning of the signature
Only a scanned image of the handwritten signature
The model version and prompt used to draft the record
questions.why: Section 11.50 requires the printed name, the date and time of signing, and the meaning such as review or approval.

questions.q: To save effort, the team runs the AI assistant under the investigator's own login. What is wrong with that?
options: The trail shows the person wrote what the AI wrote
It costs more in licences for every investigator
The model runs much slower under a personal account
Nothing is wrong, since the investigator approves it anyway
questions.why: Records must be attributable. The AI needs its own service identity so the trail is honest.

questions.q: A developer edits the prompt on a validated tool to fix a small wording issue. What should happen?
options: Nothing, because prompts are not really code
Tell the users about the change in a chat message
Wait for the annual periodic review to record it
Raise a change control and rerun the tests
questions.why: Prompts shape behaviour, so they are configuration under change control with impact assessment and retesting.

questions.q: Which automation level is the usual default for AI that drafts GMP records?
options: Fully automated, with no human step at any point at all
Assistive only, so the AI may never draft anything
Semi-automated: AI drafts, a qualified person approves
Whatever level the AI vendor recommends in its guide
questions.why: AI drafts and checks while a qualified person reviews and approves, keeping GMP decisions with people.

questions.q: Why pin a specific model version for a validated AI step?
options: So validated behaviour does not change without control
Because pinned versions are always cheaper to run per call
Because newer models are not allowed in pharma use
Because it makes the model answer faster for every user
questions.why: If the model changes underneath you, the evidence from validation no longer describes what is running.

questions.q: What is the first document you write when designing an AI step for GMP use?
options: The user training slides
The validation summary report
The vendor contract
The intended use
questions.why: Intended use drives the risk assessment, the requirements and how much testing is needed.
